scenes.text: Deep space relay nine-oh-four has one job: pass messages between Earth and the outer fleet.
scenes.art_prompt: a lone deep-space relay satellite drifting in black void, faint Earth distant, cinematic wide shot

scenes.text: Last week it transmitted an outbound message and logged the reply the same second.
scenes.art_prompt: a cold dim relay control console at night, one glowing screen, empty room, blue light

scenes.text: The reply came from the outbound queue. It had not been sent yet.
scenes.art_prompt: a wall of blinking status lights on a dark satellite panel, one light out of sequence

scenes.text: The crew pulled the raw log. Every outbound message, answered before it left the dish.
scenes.art_prompt: a printed data log unspooling across a metal table, timestamps glowing, tense close-up

scenes.text:
The final entry was a reply to a message the relay will send next year.
It already knew what we will ask.
scenes.art_prompt: a satellite silhouette against a vast dark nebula, stars, quiet and final

scenes.text: Follow Deep Space Logs for the next transmission.
scenes.art_prompt: a silent relay antenna aimed at empty space, single star behind it, final wide shot
